## Automated Test Requirements

Tests sit beside their module (project convention), not under `tests/`:
- `src/state/appStore.test.ts`: one describe block per story (EC-001 L760, EC-003 L876, EC-005 L998, EC-006 L1051, EC-007 L1153, EC-008 L1234, EC-002 L1317, EC-009 L1458, EC-010 L1578, EC-012 L1709), plus `applyDebrief apply-once (ADR-0021)` L525
- `src/state/worldStore.test.ts` L481: a failed generated contract leaves the market (EC-009)
- `src/game/world.test.ts`: squad-caused vs CorpSec civilian hit counting (EC-005's upstream; L1110 "a CorpSec hit through a civilian hurts them but bills nothing")

## Manual QA Scope

None required. No Visual/Feel or UI story is in scope; the invoice UI is EC-022, a later sprint. The live-browser flow (win, loss, quiet replay, research/hire debit and refusal, save/reload) was already walked by `/smoke-check` on 2026-10-14.

## Out of Scope

- EC-004, EC-011, EC-013 through EC-022: not in Sprint 3
- Rendering/performance: the 181 ms World Network frame in the smoke check is advisory; no Sprint 3 story touches rendering
